description: Reference notification policy of the JBS Procurement pack. Data, not code: every event, recipient rule, template and reminder window here is editable configuration.

legalReturned.body: Legal returned {{contract.reference}} ({{contract.title}}) for rework. Respond and resubmit here: {{link}}
